vulnerabilities.summary: JNDI lookup handling in affected Log4j Core releases can permit attacker-controlled lookup behavior under vulnerable configurations and usage.
OpenSSL ASN.1 object identifier translation can consume excessive CPU and cause denial of service in affected versions.
OpenSSL DH parameter checking can spend excessive time validating a malicious q parameter.
curl security advisory: SOCKS5 heap buffer overflow.
OpenSSL PKCS12 decoding can dereference a null pointer and crash on maliciously formatted files.
curl security advisory: OCSP verification bypass with TLS session reuse.
PostgreSQL row security can disregard user-ID changes in affected query-plan reuse cases.
PostgreSQL libpq can retain an attacker-controlled error message from a man-in-the-middle.
PostgreSQL SET ROLE / SET SESSION AUTHORIZATION can reset to the wrong user ID.
PostgreSQL PL/Perl environment-variable handling can enable arbitrary code execution.
curl security advisory: netrc and redirect credential leak.
CPython tarfile extraction filters can permit modification of metadata or permissions on files outside the intended extraction directory.
curl security advisory: usage of disabled protocol.
curl security advisory: QUIC certificate check bypass with wolfSSL.
curl security advisory: HTTP/2 push headers memory leak.
curl security advisory: TLS certificate check bypass with mbedTLS.
nginx HTTP/3 processing can use freed memory in affected releases.
OpenSSL TLS 1.3 session handling can permit unbounded memory growth in affected versions.
Malicious code was introduced into specific XZ Utils release tarballs, affecting liblzma in the identified 5.6.0 and 5.6.1 releases.
Git submodule clone path confusion on case-insensitive filesystems can permit unintended hook execution during recursive clone operations.
A crafted local Git repository can cause code execution when cloned in affected releases.
Affected Git local-clone behavior can hard-link repository objects owned by another user, allowing later modification of cloned object data.
Affected Git local clones can hard-link arbitrary user-readable files through crafted symlinked object paths.
Protections intended to make sanitizing untrusted Git repositories safe can be bypassed in affected releases.
Apache HTTP Server on Windows can permit SSRF through UNC path handling in affected releases.
Apache HTTP Server 2.4.60 can disclose source when legacy content-type handler configuration is used.
Apache HTTP Server 2.4.60 and 2.4.61 can disclose local source code with certain legacy handler mappings.
Apache HTTP Server on Windows with mod_rewrite can permit SSRF to UNC paths and potential NTLM credential disclosure.
Apache HTTP Server core response-header handling can permit HTTP response splitting in affected releases.
OpenSSL DSA key and parameter validation can consume excessive CPU for excessively large untrusted parameters.
OpenSSL SSL_free_buffers can trigger a use-after-free in affected versions when the API is used in vulnerable call patterns.
Affected Git releases can render attacker-controlled ANSI escape sequences in interactive credential prompts derived from malicious URLs, enabling misleading terminal prompts.
Affected Git releases incompletely sanitize carriage-return handling in the credential-helper protocol, allowing malicious repository URLs to influence helper fields in vulnerable integrations.
OpenSSL SSL_select_next_proto can overread a buffer when called with an empty client protocol list.
curl security advisory: freeing stack buffer in utf8asn1str.
Portable OpenSSH sshd signal-handler race can permit remote code execution with root privileges on affected systems.
curl security advisory: macidn punycode buffer overread.
curl security advisory: ASN.1 date parser overread.
nginx ngx_http_mp4_module can overread a buffer in affected releases.
PostgreSQL relation replacement during pg_dump can execute arbitrary SQL.
curl security advisory: OCSP stapling bypass with GnuTLS.
OpenSSL low-level GF(2^m) APIs can access memory out of bounds with invalid explicit curve parameters.
curl security advisory: HSTS subdomain overwrites parent cache entry.
curl security advisory: netrc and default credential leak.
curl security advisory: eventfd double close.
curl security advisory: gzip integer overflow.
curl security advisory: predictable WebSocket mask.
curl security advisory: missing SFTP host verification with wolfSSH.
curl security advisory: no QUIC certificate pinning with GnuTLS.
curl security advisory: broken TLS options for threaded LDAPS.
curl security advisory: bearer token leak on cross-protocol redirect.
curl security advisory: OpenSSL partial-chain store policy bypass.
curl security advisory: libssh global known_hosts override.
curl security advisory: libssh key passphrase bypass without agent set.
nginx SSL session reuse can cross security contexts in affected releases.
CPython tarfile extraction filtering can be bypassed to create crafted symlinks outside the intended extraction directory when using the data filter.
CPython tarfile extraction filtering can be bypassed so crafted symlink targets escape the destination directory and selected metadata can be modified outside it.
CPython tarfile filtering with TarFile.errorlevel=0 can extract members that the active extraction filter rejected instead of skipping them.
CPython tarfile extraction filtering can be bypassed to write files outside the intended extraction directory when extracting untrusted archives with the data filter.
Affected Git releases mishandle trailing carriage returns in submodule paths, which can redirect checkout into a hooks directory and enable unintended post-checkout hook execution.
Affected Git clients insufficiently validate advertised bundle URIs during clone, permitting protocol injection and arbitrary local bundle write locations.
curl security advisory: QUIC certificate check skip with wolfSSL.
curl security advisory: no QUIC certificate pinning with wolfSSL.
curl security advisory: WebSocket endless loop.
Apache HTTP Server 2.4.64 incorrectly evaluates RewriteCond expr tests as true.
Apache HTTP Server mod_md can overflow an ACME retry backoff timer and retry without delay after repeated failures.
Apache HTTP Server SSI with mod_cgid can pass a shell-escaped query string to exec directives in affected configurations.
curl security advisory: out-of-bounds read for cookie path.
curl security advisory: HTTP/2 stream-dependency tree use-after-free.
curl security advisory: QUIC zero-length UDP datagrams busy-loop.
curl security advisory: Native CA trust persist.
curl security advisory: WS Auto-PONG memory exhaustion.
curl security advisory: cross-origin Digest auth state leak.
curl security advisory: proto-default skips SSH verification.
PHP HTTP stream TLS setup failure can dereference cleaned-up peer state and remotely terminate an FPM process.

references.title: TLS setup failure can result in remote denial of service

vulnerabilities.summary: PHP ext/openssl AES-WRAP-PAD encryption can under-allocate its output buffer and corrupt Zend heap metadata.

references.title: Memory corruption in openssl_encrypt with AES-WRAP-PAD

vulnerabilities.summary: SQL injection in PHP ext-pgsql conversion helpers can allow crafted values to break out of E-string quoting.

references.title: SQL injection in ext-pgsql via E-string backslash breakout

vulnerabilities.summary: PHP BCMath bccomp() can perform an out-of-bounds write when crafted operands interact with scale truncation.
curl security advisory: bad reuse of HTTP Negotiate connection.
Apache HTTP Server 2.4.66 HTTP/2 early reset handling can double free memory and may permit code execution.
Apache HTTP Server modules using ap_expr can allow local .htaccess authors to read files with the httpd identity in affected releases.
net/url insufficiently validates some host and authority components and accepts malformed URL forms.
Go crypto/x509 certificate verification can panic for chains combining an empty DNS name with excluded name constraints.
On Unix systems, directory enumeration through os.Root can return metadata for a file outside the root boundary.
The go command can allow build-time code smuggling through crafted SWIG filenames containing cgo-related names.
html/template does not correctly escape URL actions in meta refresh content attributes, allowing possible XSS.
The Go compiler can mis-handle induction-variable overflow checks and permit invalid indexing that can result in runtime memory corruption.
The Go compiler can misclassify overlapping memory moves after a no-op interface conversion, potentially causing memory corruption.
nginx ngx_http_dav_module can overflow a buffer in affected releases.
nginx ngx_http_mp4_module can overflow a buffer in affected releases.
Apache HTTP Server mod_ldap can use freed memory in affected per-directory configurations.
rsync security advisory: TOCTOU symlink race in daemon mode without chroot.
html/template can lose JavaScript template-literal context across branches or brace-depth changes, leading to incorrect escaping and possible XSS.
Apache HTTP Server 2.4.66 mod_auth_digest is vulnerable to a timing attack that can bypass Digest authentication.
Apache HTTP Server mod_authn_socache can dereference a null pointer and crash a child process in affected caching forward-proxy configurations.
Multiple Apache HTTP Server modules can forward a malicious status line and permit HTTP response splitting with untrusted backends.
Apache HTTP Server mod_proxy_ajp getter functions can read beyond bounds in affected releases.
curl security advisory: token leak with redirect and netrc.
curl security advisory: wrong proxy connection reuse with credentials.
curl security advisory: use after free in SMB connection reuse.
The go tool pack extraction path does not sufficiently sanitize archive output names and can write outside the intended directory for malicious archives.
On Unix systems, os.Root can follow a final-component symlink outside the root when a path ends with a slash.
html/template can fail to escape URLs correctly in meta refresh content when whitespace surrounds the equals delimiter.
html/template can apply incorrect escaping inside script elements with empty or whitespace type attributes.
Go net dialing and port lookup can panic on Windows when supplied an input containing a NUL byte.
nginx resolver OCSP handling can use freed memory in affected releases.
nginx HTTP proxy v2 and gRPC modules can overflow a buffer in affected releases.
The go command can accept an invalid empty or unrelated checksum-database response from a malicious module proxy, allowing checksum validation bypass for downloaded modules or toolchains.
Go crypto/tls Encrypted Client Hello handshakes can disclose pre-shared-key identities in the unencrypted ClientHello, weakening ECH anonymity.
nginx HTTP/3 handling can use freed memory in affected mainline releases.
nginx map and regular-expression processing can overflow a buffer in affected releases.
nginx ngx_http_proxy_module can permit HTTP/2 request injection in affected releases.
nginx ngx_http_rewrite_module can overflow a buffer in affected releases.
rsync security advisory: hostname/ACL bypass with daemon chroot DNS lookup failure.
rsync security advisory: compressed-token decoder integer overflow can disclose memory.
rsync security advisory: symlink races in daemon mode without chroot.
rsync security advisory: out-of-bounds read in recv_files can cause remote denial of service.
rsync security advisory: HTTP CONNECT proxy response off-by-one stack write.
nginx ngx_http_charset_module can read beyond a buffer in affected releases.
Node.js proxy tunnel errors can expose proxy credentials embedded in proxy URLs through logs or other error consumers.
Node.js Permission Model path validation can allow process report output outside an intended filesystem write allowlist.
Node.js TLS hostname normalization can disagree with resolver/verifier handling of Unicode dot separators and weaken wildcard-depth identity checks.
Node.js HTTP/2 clients can grow memory without bound when a peer supplies attacker-controlled ORIGIN frames.
curl security advisory: connection reuse ignores TLS requirement.
Node.js SNI context selection can perform case-sensitive hostname matching and weaken authorization in multi-context mTLS deployments.
Node.js resolver bindings can truncate embedded-NUL hostnames and create authority-rebinding inconsistencies.
Node.js HTTP Agent response handling has a race condition that can associate an early response with a later request.
Node.js WebCrypto AES output-length handling can abort the process on very large inputs, causing denial of service.
Node.js TLS session reuse can cross server-name identity boundaries and bypass expected host verification.
Node.js Permission Model restrictions can be bypassed through promise-based FileHandle metadata operations.
Node.js 26 Permission Model network restrictions can be bypassed by creating a Unix-domain-socket server.
Node.js HTTP/2 sessions can remain active after GOAWAY on invalid-protocol paths, enabling resource exhaustion behavior.
curl security advisory: wrong reuse of HTTP Negotiate connection.
nginx ngx_http_ssi_module can use freed memory in affected releases.
Node.js HTTP/2 retained header blocks can evade maxSessionMemory accounting and cause remote memory exhaustion.
Node.js Permission Model enforcement can allow trace-event output outside an intended filesystem write allowlist.
Node.js HTTP/2 re-entrant send handling can trigger a heap use-after-free.
Node.js HTTPS Agent reuse can collide PFX object-array identities and reuse an mTLS client identity across distinct certificates.
curl security advisory: wrong reuse of SMB connection.
Node.js Permission Model enforcement can allow process-report writes outside an intended filesystem write allowlist.
Node.js HTTPS Agent TLS session reuse can skip hostname verification across differing identity policies.
Node.js node:sqlite SQLTagStore iterator reuse can re-execute a cached write statement after reset and rebinding.
Node.js dns.resolveAny() can abort the process when a DNS response contains an excessive number of A records.
Node.js Permission Model radix-tree path matching can over-grant filesystem access beyond an intended allowlist prefix.
Node.js HTTP header truncation behavior can desynchronize forwarding proxies that rebuild headers while streaming the original body.
Node.js synchronous zlib APIs can hit a reachable assertion when presented with a spoofed TypedArray byte length.
nginx ngx_http_slice_module can disclose memory in affected releases.
PHP mbstring encoding-name handling can read past global buffers when processing attacker-controlled encoding names.
curl security advisory: proxy credentials leak over redirect-to proxy.
curl security advisory: stale custom cookie host causes cookie leak.
Windows Presentation Foundation out-of-bounds write and heap-buffer handling can permit local privilege-impacting code execution in affected .NET Windows Desktop runtime releases.
Windows Presentation Foundation integer-overflow handling can permit local elevation of privilege in affected .NET Windows Desktop runtime releases.
Windows Presentation Foundation integer-overflow handling can permit local code execution in affected .NET Windows Desktop runtime releases.
Microsoft QUIC use-after-free handling can disclose information over the network on affected Windows .NET runtime releases.
System.Net.HttpListener can inconsistently interpret HTTP requests, enabling request-smuggling security-feature bypass on affected Linux and macOS .NET runtime releases.
System.Net.WebSockets can process attacker-controlled loop conditions in a way that permits remote denial of service in affected .NET runtime releases.
Windows Presentation Foundation document processing can include functionality from an untrusted control sphere and disclose information in affected .NET Windows Desktop runtime releases.
.NET diagnostics IPC can apply an improper ACL to a shared resource, permitting local elevation of privilege on affected Linux and macOS runtime releases.
curl security advisory: netrc credential leak with reused proxy connection.
PHP SOAP apache:Map reference tracking can expose a use-after-free that may permit remote code execution.
